name: Prompt Potion Runner

angles.text: As an Undead, you know brittle joints and decaying knees can hinder vital Royal Apothecary Society laboratory work.
As a member of the Horde, you can help the Forsaken with dangerous alchemical work in Undercity, where travelers must cross toxic slime canals.

faq.answer: Alessandro in Undercity needs you to carry the delivery. His undead knees pop out and rattle when he tries to run, so he cannot race across the slime canal himself.

aliases: where do you take the potion
faq.answer: Take the potion to Doctor Martin Felben at the Apothecarium in Undercity, where he conducts alchemical experiments.
faq.q: Where does the potion need to go?

faq.answer: The concoction is unstable and has a very short shelf life. Carry it quickly across the canal or it will destabilize and become useless.
Doctor Martin Felben says the six potions Alessandro tried to send before this one destabilized before reaching the Apothecarium.
Alessandro says his knees rattle and pop out whenever he tries to run. These effects of undeath keep him from rushing the delivery himself.
faq.q: Why can't Alessandro deliver the potion himself?

aliases: what is the potion used for
faq.answer: Doctor Martin Felben is an apothecary who conducts experiments in the Apothecarium. The exact formula remains obscure, and he resumes his research when the stable mixture arrives.

sections.body: Alessandro needs a swift courier in Undercity’s underground corridors. The Forsaken alchemist has made a volatile brew that will soon spoil. His undead joints are too frail for him to cross the toxic slime canal, so you carry it intact before it turns to useless sludge.
sections.title: A Race Against Decay

sections.body: Doctor Martin Felben waits at the Apothecarium for the brew, which he needs for his ongoing research. He says the six potions Alessandro sent before this one destabilized in transit. A timely delivery lets the doctor continue his shadowy experiments without interruption. The unstable brew and Alessandro’s frail joints show the hazards of Forsaken alchemy and undeath.
sections.title: The Apothecarium's Demands

summary: In Undercity, a runner carries Alessandro’s brew across the slime canal before it spoils. The delivery must reach the Apothecarium in time.
